stock.description: Jiaxin International Resources Investment Limited is primarily engaged in the tungsten mining sector. The company's core operations encompass the prospecting, development, and management of the Boguty tungsten mine, which is situated in the Republic of Kazakhstan. Established in 2014, its corporate headquarters are located in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
